projects.title: What I build on my own initiative

cvOptimizer.name: CV Optimizer Pro
cvOptimizer.desc: Multi-agent system with Claude acting as senior recruiter, hiring manager and career coach. Extracts the real profile through conversational interview and generates CVs with verified credibility.
cvOptimizer.problem: CV optimizers inflate achievements with generic phrases that a recruiter detects in seconds.
cvOptimizer.solution: 3 Claude agents (recruiter, coach, anti-exaggeration auditor) + semantic job matching + application Kanban.

jobHunter.name: Job Hunter Platform
jobHunter.desc: Platform with 116+ REST endpoints that scrapes job offers every 6h from 7 sources, applies semantic matching and generates CVs in 4 styles with real-time dashboard.
jobHunter.problem: Manual job searching consumes hours and generic CVs have low response rates.
jobHunter.solution: Celery + Redis pipeline for async scraping, AI ranking and React dashboard with real-time metrics.

tcg.name: TCG Collection Manager
tcg.desc: Card collection management with price scraping, computer vision condition analysis, OCR and React Native app to scan physical cards from camera.
tcg.problem: Inventorying physical card collections is tedious and card prices fluctuate constantly.
tcg.solution: Streamlit dashboard + TCGPlayer scraping + mobile app with OpenCV and Tesseract OCR for condition analysis.

pokemontcgai.name: Pokémon TCG AI Battle Agent
pokemontcgai.desc: AI agent for the Pokémon TCG battle simulator, built for the Kaggle 2026 competition. Trains decision policies via multi-agent reinforcement learning on the competition's official engine.
pokemontcgai.problem: Picking the optimal move in a card game with hidden information and massive combinatorial interactions is intractable with fixed rules.
pokemontcgai.solution: Training pipeline with Stable-Baselines3 and PettingZoo on top of kaggle-environments, iterating on runs of n≥1000 games to validate every policy improvement.

financial.name: Family Finance
financial.desc: Multi-platform family expense management app with AI financial analysis, voice expense entry via webhooks and family role permissions. 80% complete, 11 screens.
financial.problem: Family expense management is fragmented and lacks intelligent analysis.
financial.solution: Multi-platform Flutter with Riverpod, GPT-4o-mini for financial insights and Cloud Functions for voice webhooks (Google Assistant/Siri).

nocheAustral.name: Noche Austral
nocheAustral.desc: Complete astronomy outreach platform as graduation project: Flutter app (16,000+ lines) + Django web CMS deployed on Google Cloud.
nocheAustral.problem: The university needed an astronomy outreach platform with mobile app and web CMS for editorial management.
nocheAustral.solution: Flutter app with moon phases, ISS tracker, NASA APOD, 3 educational games and Firebase Auth. Django CMS with articles, comments and GCP App Engine deploy.
